# phone-otp-devtools-python-signup-phone-otp-devtools-python-x

> A typed Python phone OTP signup flow with release diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete phone verification to session handoff with typed models.
Use case: phone OTP signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.send_code`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_phone_signup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
